decisions.reason: As a close-to-core digital workflow module with an initially prominent launch, it still fits the firm's move toward connected practice processes and is likely worth retaining despite limited later visibility.
A continuing-education institute is more operationally demanding and less central than the software business, and the weak website signal suggests the option did not justify further commitment.
Remote screen-sharing support is useful but easy to commoditize or absorb into normal support operations, so as a separate product it is not compelling enough to keep open.
Practice analytics is a strong adjacent software option that matches the firm's innovation path and can add value across its installed customer base, so it merits continuation.
A complete practice bundle is very close to the established offer, leverages the firm's broad product base, and should be kept as a low-uncertainty cross-selling package.
A job and practice listing portal is distant from the firm's core capabilities and customer workflow software, and with many better-aligned options it should be abandoned.
